title: The challan SMS

beats.say: Papa got a challan SMS. Pay five hundred rupees in a day, install this app.
beats.show: Papa got a challan SMS. Pay Rs 500 in a day, install this app.

screen.title: SMS to Papa
screen.body:
Rs 500 traffic challan pending.
Pay in 24 hrs or your licence will be blocked.
Install: eChallan_Pay.apk

beats.say: That sounds urgent. You're absolutely right to pay it quickly.
You're absolutely right. It's fake. I'm so sorry.
Don't tap it! Type the e challan site yourself, then the scooter number!
beats.show: Don't tap it! Type the e-challan site yourself, then the scooter number!

screen.title: Fake challan SMS?
screen.body:
1. Don't tap. No app files, ever.
2. Type echallan.parivahan.gov.in yourself.
3. Get Challan Details, then the vehicle number.
4. Report the SMS on Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi).

Comment CHALLAN for the steps

beats.say: Done! I also told the family group Papa's in trouble!

caption:
papa got a rs 500 challan sms with an app to install. his scooter hasn't left the gate since diwali.

never tap a challan link or install an app file from an sms. type echallan.parivahan.gov.in yourself, open get challan details, enter the vehicle number, and pay only there if it's real.

which step did you not know? just the number.

Comment CHALLAN and I'll DM you the exact steps, the official links and a message to forward to your parents.
